mapper.select: WITH std AS ( SELECT (CASE WHEN rcnt_appr_date = (CASE WHEN check_cycle = '1' /*(1:분기/2:월)*/ THEN pre_quarter_last_day ELSE pre_month_last_day END) THEN (CASE WHEN check_cycle = '1' THEN pre_quarter_last_day ELSE pre_month_last_day END) ELSE (CASE WHEN check_cycle = '1' THEN ppre_quarter_last_day ELSE ppre_month_last_day END) END) + 1 AS start_date FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT MAX(apr01_effect_date) FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_reg_emp_id = #{personId} AND apr01_effect_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') --(40:반려/99:임시저장) AND apr01_class_tree_id IN ( SELECT dcr30_class_tree_id FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = apr01_company_id AND dcr30_link_cd = 'A09' ) /* (A09:자기매매 실거래 보고) */ ) AS rcnt_appr_date , ( SELECT flt02_check_cycle FROM flt02_emp WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS check_cycle , f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'1') AS pre_quarter_last_day , f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'2') AS ppre_quarter_last_day , (date_trunc('month', CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) + INTERVAL '-1day')::date AS pre_month_last_day , (date_trunc('month', CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) + INTERVAL '-1month -1day')::date AS ppre_month_last_day ) t ) SELECT flt11_book_id AS book_id , TO_CHAR(flt11_book_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS book_date , flt11_account_no AS account_no , flt11_item_type AS item_type , flt11_item_type_nm AS item_type_name , flt11_item_nm AS item_name , flt11_item_cd AS item_code , flt11_book_amt AS book_amt , flt11_book_qty AS book_qty , CASE WHEN flt11_buy_date IS NULL THEN '' ELSE f_get_biz_days(flt11_company_id, flt11_buy_date, flt11_book_date)-1||' 영업일' END AS book_days , TO_CHAR(flt11_buy_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS buy_date , f_get_floorTrFundHoldCheck( flt11_company_id, flt11_item_cd, flt11_book_date) AS check_fund_hold_yn , COALESCE(flt05_lock_up_check_yn::boolean, false) AS lockup_check_yn , TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN flt01_lock_up_cd != '1' THEN null ELSE (CASE WHEN flt01_lock_up_calc_std_cd = 'M' THEN flt11_buy_date + INTERVAL '1month' * COALESCE(flt01_lock_up_days,0) ELSE f_get_biz_date(flt11_company_id, flt11_buy_date, COALESCE(flt01_lock_up_days,0)::text) END) END, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lockup_date , flt11_family_relate_cd AS family_relate_code , flt11_account_id AS account_id , flt11_account_info AS account_info FROM ( SELECT * , flt05_item_type_nm AS flt11_item_type_nm , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ')' AS flt11_account_no , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' (' || sys15_corp_nm || ') ' || flt03_account_nm AS flt11_account_info , f_get_floorTrRcntBuyDate( flt11_company_id, flt11_person_id, flt11_account_id , flt11_item_type, flt11_item_nm, flt11_item_cd , flt11_book_date, true ) AS flt11_buy_date , flt03_family_relate_cd AS flt11_family_relate_cd FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() as flt11_book_id , flt11_company_id , flt11_person_id , flt11_account_id , flt11_item_cd , flt11_item_nm , flt11_item_type , flt11_book_date , SUM(flt11_book_amt) as flt11_book_amt , SUM(flt11_book_qty) as flt11_book_qty , MIN(flt11_init_buy_date) as flt11_init_buy_date FROM ( SELECT * FROM flt11_book WHERE flt11_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt11_person_id = #{personId} AND flt11_account_id = #{accountId} AND flt11_book_date = CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) UNION SELECT flt10_tr_id as flt11_book_id , flt10_company_id as flt11_company_id , flt10_person_id as flt11_person_id , flt10_account_id as flt11_account_id , flt10_item_nm as flt11_item_nm , flt10_item_type as flt11_item_type , CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) as flt11_book_date , flt10_expect_tr_amt * CASE WHEN SUBSTR(flt10_tr_type,3,1) = 'O' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END as flt11_book_amt , flt10_expect_tr_qty * CASE WHEN SUBSTR(flt10_tr_type,3,1) = 'O' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END as flt11_book_qty , null as flt11_note , flt10_reg_date as flt11_init_buy_date , TRUNC(flt10_expect_tr_amt / flt10_expect_tr_qty) as flt11_pur_price , flt10_expect_tr_amt as flt11_pur_amt , flt10_item_cd as flt11_item_cd FROM flt10_tr , std WHERE flt10_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt10_person_id = #{personId} AND flt10_account_id = #{accountId} AND flt10_reg_date BETWEEN std.start_date AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND flt10_tr_date is null AND COALESCE(flt10_status_cd,'00') IN ('10','20') AND COALESCE(flt10_unfill_yn,'false') != 'true' /*미체결 사전신고거래 제외*/ ) book GROUP BY flt11_company_id, flt11_person_id, flt11_account_id, flt11_item_cd, flt11_item_nm, flt11_item_type, flt11_book_date ) t INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt11_account_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt11_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt11_item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt11_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt11_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt11_book_date ) ) , ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) flt01 ) a WHERE CONCAT(flt11_item_nm, flt11_item_cd) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY flt11_account_no, flt11_item_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc, flt11_item_type

SELECT flt01_lock_up_cd AS lock_up_code , flt01_lock_up_days AS lock_up_days , flt01_lock_up_calc_std_cd AS lock_up_calc_std_code FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
